name: sistema-gestion-ventas
description: Sistema de gestión de ventas con suites de calidad automatizadas

scripts.test: npm run test:unit && npm run test:api && npm run test:negative && npm run test:negative-all && npm run test:e2e && npm run report
scripts.report: node "7. Reportes y tendencias de pruebas/unireport.cjs"
scripts.test:unit: mocha "1. Unitarias (cliente y servidor)/unit.test.js" --timeout 5000 --reporter mochawesome --reporter-options "reportDir=1. Unitarias (cliente y servidor)/reports/unitarias,reportFilename=unit-test-report,overwrite=true,html=true,json=true"
scripts.test:client-gap-ui: mocha "3. End-to-End (E2E) en navegador/gaps/client-email-gap.spec.js" --timeout 60000 --reporter mochawesome --reporter-options "reportDir=3. End-to-End (E2E) en navegador/reports/gaps/mochawesome,reportFilename=client-email-ui-gap-report,overwrite=true,html=true,json=true"
scripts.test:client-a11y-gaps: mocha "3. End-to-End (E2E) en navegador/gaps/client-accessibility-gap.spec.js" --timeout 60000 --reporter mochawesome --reporter-options "reportDir=3. End-to-End (E2E) en navegador/reports/mochawesome,reportFilename=client-accessibility-report,overwrite=true,html=true,json=true"
scripts.test:e2e: mocha "3. End-to-End (E2E) en navegador/specs/**/*.spec.js" "3. End-to-End (E2E) en navegador/gaps/client-accessibility-gap.spec.js" --timeout 60000 --reporter mochawesome --reporter-options "reportDir=3. End-to-End (E2E) en navegador/reports/mochawesome,reportFilename=e2e-report,overwrite=true,html=true,json=true"
scripts.test:coverage: npm run test:coverage:unit && npm run test:coverage:backend && npm run test:coverage:frontend
scripts.test:coverage:unit: c8 --reporter=text --reporter=html --reporter=json-summary --reports-dir "4. Cobertura de código (JavaScript)/reports" --temp-directory "node_modules/.cache/c8" --check-coverage --lines 90 --functions 90 --branches 90 mocha "1. Unitarias (cliente y servidor)/unit.test.js" --timeout 5000 --reporter mochawesome --reporter-options "reportDir=1. Unitarias (cliente y servidor)/reports/unitarias,reportFilename=unit-test-report,overwrite=true,html=true,json=true"
scripts.test:coverage:backend: c8 --all --include "backend/**/*.js" --exclude "backend/scripts/**" --exclude "backend/seed_passwords.js" --reporter=text --reporter=html --reporter=json-summary --reports-dir "4. Cobertura de código (JavaScript)/reports/backend-app" --temp-directory "node_modules/.cache/c8-backend" node scripts/run-backend-coverage.cjs
scripts.lint:report: eslint --ext .js,.ts,.tsx --max-warnings 37 backend frontend/src --format json --output-file "5. Análisis estático (complejidad, code smells)/reports/static-analysis-report.json"
scripts.docker:seed: docker compose exec -T backend node seed_passwords.js
